editorial:
You follow a senior police chief who kills his lover, then starts leaving clues that point right back to him. He does not run or hide; instead, he leads the investigation and watches everyone around him ignore the truth. The movie has a sharp, uneasy mood and a slow, tense pace that makes you feel like you are trapped inside a system that protects its own people. It is less about solving a crime and more about power, pride, and how authority can bend the rules without seeming to break them.

The lead performance is strong and unsettling, and the story keeps you guessing about how far he will go. The pacing can feel slow, and some scenes are cold or uncomfortable, so it may not work for viewers wanting fast action. Still, if you enjoy dark thrillers with a social message, this one is worth your time.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, he openly confesses to the murder and waits for the handcuffs. The twist is that the system still protects him, so he is not punished for the killing. Instead, he is finally arrested for political reasons, showing that power, not truth, decides who gets punished. You realize the law only works against people without power in the end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark thrillers with a social message.
